name: Olfan Zairud
original_name: オルファン・ザイルード
source: Marshal governing over Malucia South Capital Dinasty as well as the prime minister of the empire. Has a clear mind and unwavering belief, in order to achieve his purpose, he is ready to do anything necessary to reach his goal. He is searching for a feasible and perfect alternative to Mag-Tech weapons, one that will not have their limitations and will not change over the course of time. He is also the mentor of Weissheit, and father of Liselle.
